title: Microsoft Research Asia marks one year of operations in Singapore
excerpt: The lab has collaborated on nine new research projects with local universities since its July 24, 2025 opening.
bodyHtml:
Microsoft Research Asia – Singapore marked one year of operations following its July 24, 2025 opening. The facility serves as the company's first research lab in Southeast Asia.

During its first year, the lab established nine new research projects with the National University of Singapore and Nanyang Technological University. These projects focus on areas including healthcare AI, robotics, and multi-agent systems, which are systems that can reason, plan, use tools, and collaborate with people.

The lab's work includes the Industrial Postgraduate Programme, which supports joint PhD training. The first student in this program, Qiming Huang, presented a paper on RobotSeg, a foundation model for robot segmentation in image and video, at the CVPR 2026 conference.
topic: One year in: How Microsoft Research Asia – Singapore is advancing research, partnership and talent for real-world impact
